items.type:
∀ {G : Type u_7} {H : Type u_8} {F : Type u_9} [inst : FunLike F G H] [inst_1 : AddGroup G]
  [inst_2 : SubtractionMonoid H] [AddMonoidHomClass F G H] (f : F) (a b : G), f (a - b) = f a - f b
items.informal_description: For any additive monoid homomorphism $ f : G \to H $ from an additive group $ G $ to a subtraction monoid $ H $, and for all $ a, b \in G $, it holds that $ f(a - b) = f(a) - f(b) $. This expresses that additive homomorphisms between these structures preserve the subtraction operation.

items.informal_description: For any additive group $\alpha$, subtraction monoid $\beta$, additive monoid homomorphism $f : \alpha \to \beta$, and elements $g, h \in \alpha$, it holds that $f(g - h) = f(g) - f(h)$.

items.informal_description: For any additive monoid homomorphism $ f : G \to H $, where $ G $ is an additive group and $ H $ is a subtraction monoid, and for all $ a, b \in G $, it holds that $ f(a - b) = f(a) - f(b) $.

items.informal_name: Additive Monoid Homomorphism Preserves Subtraction Composition
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {G : Type u_7} {H : Type u_8} {F : Type u_9} [inst : FunLike F G H] [inst_1 : AddGroup G]
  [inst_2 : SubtractionMonoid H] [AddMonoidHomClass F G H] (f : F) (g h : ι → G), ⇑f ∘ (g - h) = ⇑f ∘ g - ⇑f ∘ h
items.informal_description: For any additive monoid homomorphism $ f : G \to H $, where $ G $ is an additive group and $ H $ is a subtraction monoid, and for all functions $ g, h : \iota \to G $, the composition $ f \circ (g - h) $ equals $ f \circ g - f \circ h $. This expresses that additive monoid homomorphisms preserve subtraction operations when composed with functions from an index type $ \iota $.
